name: shotcut
title: 剪切并导出编辑过的视频
description: Get edited video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, up to 500MB), say something like "trim the silent parts, cut between scenes, and add smooth transitions", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators and video editors who move fast and want fast video cuts and edits without complex software.
title_en: Shotcut — Cut and Export Edited Videos
